1. [blocking][issue-impact][high] `RepositoryLayout::new` never compares the no-follow root identities. Lexically disjoint aliases (for example, a bind-mounted worktree and data root) with the same physical identity are accepted and merely recorded in `InjectivityProof`, so distinct `Worktree` and `Data` paths can resolve to the same repository object. This violates the required virtual-to-physical injectivity and alias rejection. `crates/jit/src/repository_state/path.rs:193`

2. [blocking][issue-impact][high] The new `declarations` subsystem is not filesystem-free: `RuleSet::load` reads `rules.toml` and referenced schemas, while `from_toml_str_with_loaders` falls back to `JitConfig::load` when no config is supplied. Live command paths call this loader directly, leaving declaration parsing able to reopen ambient repository state instead of requiring captured inputs. `crates/jit/src/declarations/rules.rs:775`
